summary: All 56 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all seven reported values reproduced. The reviewed sources yielded no comparable author effects for any of the three registered populations, supporting confirmed_not_located. The corrected proposal links directly to the records inspected and removes the unsupported assumption that a result awaits release. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: Author effect sizes, P values, FDR and tested-gene coverage remain unassessed for all three populations.
